name: Sketch Seed 1.2.2
body:
**Install this one.** Every earlier version could destroy your sketches during a restore.

**A backup missing its images no longer deletes the images on your phone.**

Restoring rebuilt its list of usable sketches only from what the archive carried.
Anything a record referred to that was not in the archive was treated as a broken
reference and dropped — and then the matching file was swept off the device. So
restoring an archive whose images were missing brought the journey back and destroyed
every photo, from the records and from storage, leaving nothing to recover from.

That is not a rare shape. Editing a backup by hand — the only way to correct a
completion date today — makes it easy for a zip tool to rebuild the archive and lose
the images folder along the way.

A sketch already on your phone, under the name a restored record asks for, is that
sketch. It is now kept: the reference survives and the file stays. Restoring still
replaces rather than merges, so anything the restored journey does not refer to is
removed as before, and a reference to a photo that exists nowhere is still dropped.

Affects v1.0 through v1.2.1. Nothing else changed — no new permissions, no new data
collected, and no change to the journey, the streak rule or the 6am day boundary.

**If you have already lost images this way,** this release cannot bring them back.
Two places may still have them: an original export zip taken before any hand-editing,
and the previous generation kept on Drive — which each new backup overwrites, so turn
automatic backup off first if you want to preserve it.

---

`SketchSeed-1.2.2.apk` · 2.8 MB · Android 8.0+ · sideload, you will need to allow
installation from unknown sources. Signed with the same certificate as earlier
releases, so it installs over them and keeps your journey.
